title: Days-to-Surgery Deposit Percentage — Riverbend Self-Pay Outpatient Surgery Package
content:
Scheduling note for the initial deposit on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking under Good Faith & Price Estimates: a booking paid close to its surgery date carries a higher deposit percentage.

**Rule.** The days to surgery run from today's date to the scheduled service date, today not counted and the service date counted. Seven or fewer days to surgery, a passed service date included, set the deposit percentage at one hundred percent (100); eight to twenty days set it at seventy-five percent (75); twenty-one or more days leave the package's deposit percentage as it is. A percentage so set takes the place of the package's deposit percentage and is the booking's deposit percentage.

| Days to surgery | Deposit percentage of the booking |
|---|---|
| service date already passed, or today | 100 |
| 1 to 7 | 100 |
| 8 to 20 | 75 |
| 21 or more | the package's deposit percentage, unchanged |

## Boundaries (hypothetical dates)

- Today is the 1st of a month and surgery is on the 8th: 7 days to surgery, percentage 100.
- Surgery on the 9th: 8 days, percentage 75.
- Surgery on the 21st: 20 days, percentage 75.
- Surgery on the 22nd: 21 days, the package's deposit percentage stands.
